feed.title: UK Online Shelf-Price Index: weekly largest category moves
feed.subtitle: The headline change and the largest category rises and falls each published week. Shelf prices only; not CPI.

entry.title: UK shelf prices, 2026-W45: headline +0.01% on the week
entry.content:
UK Online Shelf-Price Index, week 2026-W45: headline level 99.7 (base 100 at 2026-W42), +0.01% on the week before.

Largest category rises (categories with at least 100 matched products): bread cereals +0.22% (7,487 matched products); fish +0.18% (1,136 matched products); dairy eggs +0.07% (2,879 matched products); vegetables +0.07% (1,758 matched products).

Largest category falls: oils fats -0.21% (316 matched products); baby -0.20% (2,590 matched products); soft drinks -0.16% (5,522 matched products).

Levels from different base weeks are not comparable: the series restarted at week 42, and earlier entries use an earlier base. Shelf prices only; not CPI and not a measure of prices paid. Source: Yappman Data, UK Online Shelf-Price Index, CC BY 4.0, vintage 2026-W45, https://data.yappman.com/shelf-price-index/
